evidence.title: GitHub - recharts/recharts: Redefined chart library built with React and D3

name: Recharts
summary: Composable React charting library that renders SVG charts from decoupled components with a light D3 dependency.
description: Recharts builds charts in React applications from independent components - a LineChart is assembled from axis, tooltip, grid and line items - and renders them as native SVG with only a minimal dependency on D3 submodules. Charts are customized through component props and your own components. Install from npm, Deno or a UMD build; docs, API reference, examples and storybook live at recharts.github.io, where the recharts.org domain now redirects.
contains: composable charting library built with React and D3
